**Accessor applications open on 1 January 2027**, when the accessor test
suite is published. An application opened before then cannot be assessed,
because the suite it is assessed against does not exist yet.

Read GOVERNANCE.md Appendix A before opening this. The admissions check is
exhaustive: a submission cannot be returned for a reason not on that list, and
every return cites the item it failed.

## Status sought

- [ ] Registered Accessor — the application or agent passes the accessor test suite. Automated check, no human judgement.
- [ ] Verified Accessor — passes the accessor test suite, reviewed by the technical committee, and corporate identity established.

## Every submission (Appendix A items 1 to 4)

- [ ] The participation form is complete.
- [ ] Specification version this submission is made against: `vX.Y.Z`
- [ ] Accountable party, with working contact details:
- [ ] This pull request or issue carries DCO sign-off.

## The application or agent (Appendix A item 6a)

- [ ] Accessor test suite results attached, naming the suite version, with how to reproduce them.
- [ ] What it does, and what data it asks for:
- [ ] Purpose codes it requests:

## Verified Accessor only

- [ ] Legal attestation attached, naming the entity that carries liability.
- [ ] Corporate identity: an entry on a recognised trust registry (see `/register/trust-registries.json`), or the material for a KYB-style check.

## Anything else

Say anything a reviewer would otherwise have to ask for.
